AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Reads the user's calendar events and tasks from Calino, opens them in Calino, and prepares new events and tasks for the user to review. Operational patterns: - Use getAgenda for questions about a day or date range, and searchCalendar to find a specific event or task by name. - Pass an itemId from getAgenda or searchCalendar to openItem to show that item to the user. - draftEvent and draftTask never save anything. They open Calino's editor prefilled; tell the user to check the details and tap Save. Constraints: - Only downloaded events and tasks on calendars the user shows in Calino are visible. Journals, contacts, notes and attendees are not available. - Results may be incomplete for dates far from today.
